text: Local residents have expressed concern regarding the existing parking regulations on Glen Long Avenue and have proposed making changes so that the condition on the north side of the street would match those in place on the south. This would see the regulations change such that the three-hour parking limit on the north side would be revoked and that parking from 8:00am to 4:00pm (Monday to Friday) would be prohibited.

North York Community Council: 1. Directed City Clerk's staff to conduct a poll for residents on Glen Long Avenue between Haven Road and Lansdowne Avenue in order to gauge support for changing the current parking regime on the north side of the street to match regulations in place on the south.
